description: In a nonempty domain, if the binder \(u\) has no free occurrence in \(\chi\), then \((Q u\,\theta)\circ\chi\equiv Q u\,(\theta\circ\chi)\) and \(\chi\circ(Q u\,\theta)\equiv Q u\,(\chi\circ\theta)\), for \(Q\in\{\forall,\exists\}\) and \(\circ\in\{\land,\lor\}\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderNormalForms.moving_quantifiers.{u, v, w, u'} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {α : Type u'} {n : ℕ} {M : Type w} [L.Structure M] [Nonempty M] (θ : L.BoundedFormula α (n + 1))
  (χ : L.BoundedFormula α n) (a : α → M) (b : Fin n → M) :
  ((θ.all ⊓ χ).Realize a b ↔ (θ ⊓ FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.liftAt 1 n χ).all.Realize a b) ∧
    ((θ.ex ⊓ χ).Realize a b ↔ (θ ⊓ FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.liftAt 1 n χ).ex.Realize a b) ∧
      ((θ.all ⊔ χ).Realize a b ↔ (θ ⊔ FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.liftAt 1 n χ).all.Realize a b) ∧
        ((θ.ex ⊔ χ).Realize a b ↔ (θ ⊔ FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.liftAt 1 n χ).ex.Realize a b) ∧
          ((χ ⊓ θ.all).Realize a b ↔ (FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.liftAt 1 n χ ⊓ θ).all.Realize a b) ∧
            ((χ ⊓ θ.ex).Realize a b ↔ (FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.liftAt 1 n χ ⊓ θ).ex.Realize a b) ∧
              ((χ ⊔ θ.all).Realize a b ↔ (FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.liftAt 1 n χ ⊔ θ).all.Realize a b) ∧
                ((χ ⊔ θ.ex).Realize a b ↔ (FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.liftAt 1 n χ ⊔ θ).ex.Realize a b)
